original_test_intent: Qualify the complete HGX system-software stack with the owner-approved NVSSVT suite and demonstrate a true 100% pass rate over the required test population, with no skipped, unsupported, aborted or infrastructure-error result silently excluded from the denominator.
original_method: Pin NVSSVT package/container image digest, suite revision and L0/L1 selection; bind HGX hardware/firmware, OS/kernel, NVIDIA driver, CUDA, container runtime/toolkit, fabric manager and libraries to the supported matrix; define immutable configuration, test inventory and pass/fail/skip/unsupported/error denominator rules; preserve baseline; run the complete eight-hour vendor suite under maintenance monitoring; retain every test artifact and calculate 100% from the approved manifest; compare post-state and recover without altering the stack or rerunning failed subsets to improve the number.
manual_activity: Owner/NVIDIA software engineer supplies and approves the exact suite and compatibility matrix, authorizes any package/container changes, and interprets excluded or unsupported tests.
required_inputs: NVSSVT version/build/license or container digest, exact L0/L1 command/configuration and signed/hashed test manifest
Expected HGX hardware/firmware and OS/kernel/driver/CUDA/container/fabric-manager/library compatibility matrix
Expected test count and explicit PASS/FAIL/SKIP/UNSUPPORTED/ABORT/INFRA_ERROR denominator and waiver policy
Maintenance approval, workload isolation, thermal/power/driver aborts, durable storage and software-stack recovery
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated stable SUT and verify no active user GPU workloads
Do not install, upgrade or alter driver/container/runtime state without separate approval and rollback
Use trusted access and preserve kernel, GPU and BMC baseline evidence
Stop on suite hang, driver unload/reset, GPU XID, thermal/power fault, reboot, stack drift or incomplete result manifest
No selective or automatic rerun to convert a failed result
agent_execution_scope: Validate package/image, suite manifest, exact software matrix, configuration, result policy, baselines and recovery
Run only the owner-approved complete NVSSVT suite once
Retain raw per-test artifacts and calculate the pass rate from the approved expected-test manifest
Do not substitute an inventory sweep, exclude non-pass states silently, alter the stack, rerun failures automatically or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve NVSSVT build/suite/configuration and exact supported software matrix
Approve expected test manifest, denominator, waiver/skip handling, aborts and recovery
Review raw per-test evidence and decide whether the 100% criterion and PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED verdict are met

modernized_recommendation.status: MEDIUM SPECIFICATION-BOUND NVSSVT SYSTEM SOFTWARE QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Freeze a reproducible software bill of materials and expected-test manifest before execution, then derive 100% only from complete result records reconciled to that manifest.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact suite and software-stack identity, deterministic test population, non-pass accounting, complete artifacts and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A driver/OS inventory or vendor summary can look healthy while required tests were skipped, unsupported, aborted, missing or run against an unapproved stack.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: NVSSVT may load GPUs and exercise driver/container services for eight hours; stack changes or selective reruns can make results incomparable and mask defects.

project_override_considerations: A newer NVSSVT or project wrapper is acceptable only with an approved test-manifest and compatibility delta. Inventory-only checks, partial L0/L1 execution or waived results do not meet 100% unless the owner explicitly defines the denominator before the run.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, NVSSVT version/package hash or image digest/license and exact suite/configuration
Complete hardware/firmware and OS/kernel/driver/CUDA/container/fabric-manager/library inventory mapped to the supported matrix
Approved expected-test manifest/count and pass-rate denominator/waiver policy
Full per-test stdout/stderr, result files, timestamps, PASS/FAIL/SKIP/UNSUPPORTED/ABORT/INFRA_ERROR reconciliation and calculated rate
Pre/during/post GPU/driver/process/XID, dmesg/journal, BMC/SEL, thermal/power and stack-integrity evidence
Abort/recovery or stable final state and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Makes the 100% claim reproducible and prevents missing, skipped, unsupported or selectively rerun tests from disappearing behind an inventory snapshot or vendor summary.
independent_technical_reasoning: A percentage has no engineering meaning without a fixed numerator and denominator. For a vendor suite, package version and platform software matrix also determine which tests exist and are supported. Therefore the expected manifest and treatment of every non-pass state must be frozen before the run; only complete reconciled per-test results can establish 100%, and rerunning selected failures would create a different run rather than repair the original evidence.
